meta.title: Vietnam's Most Scenic Train Ride: Hue to Da Nang via Hai Van Pass
meta.description:
Sorry for the hiatus, sometimes filming so much makes the editing process overwhelming. But we’re back today with Part 1 of our Da Nang adventures in Vietnam!

Train info: http://vietnam-railway.com/train/route/train-from-hue-to-danang

Hotel: Sala Da Nang Beach Hotel
Private Driver: Trung: Whatsapp: +84905484100

Disclaimer: I’m not compensated for recommending any drivers or services. These are my personal recommendations based on who I’ve used and trust.

Join me for a first-class adventure through Central Vietnam! This travel vlog takes you on the famous Reunification Express train from the imperial city of Hue to the vibrant coastal city of Da Nang. The highlight? A breathtaking journey through the legendary Hai Van Pass, one of the most scenic train routes in the world. Get ready for panoramic views of lush mountains, sparkling coastline, and hidden lagoons.

Once in Da Nang, I'll show you how to spend the perfect two days exploring this incredible city.

Day 1: Beaches, Bridges & Buddhist Bliss
-Morning: Start with a sunrise at a stunning beach, known for its soft sand and calm waters. It's the perfect spot for a morning jog or a relaxing swim.
-Afternoon: Head to the Son Tra Peninsula and climb to the magnificent pagoda, home to the towering Lady Buddha statue. The views from the pagoda are absolutely breathtaking!
-Evening: Experience the spectacle of the Dragon Bridge fire and water show, which takes place every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at 9 PM. Grab dinner at a local seafood spot or explore the vibrant night market nearby.

Day 2: Culture, Comfort & City Sights
-Morning: Take a trip to a UNESCO World Heritage Site, an ancient complex of temples that offers a deep dive into Vietnam's rich history.
-Afternoon: After a day of exploring, unwind with a traditional Vietnamese massage. You deserve it!
-Evening: Enjoy a delicious bowl of a local noodle specialty and explore the city center.

Traveler Tips:
Laundry: Look for local shops that charge by the kilogram for a convenient and affordable service.

comments.author: @randomrichardhere
comments.text: Best to book train online. Tip: look for the sleeper car trains. There are four sleepers per cabin and costs about $15 and less for booking top bunk. I traveled alone but booked top and bottom bunk from Hue to Da Nang but ironically all the people who were on the train were overnight and so the whole train unloaded and when we/i got on it was literally just me and an aussie couple who had the whole car to ourselves. Plenty of room for luggage and could enjoy the view. Hai van pass is okay but overrated. Just don't blink or you miss the best view which of hai van bridge and start of lang co beach 😁
